{{Top|leg}}
'''Hutt's Tail''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] found in the center of the [[Red Sector]] of [[Nirama's public asteroid]]. It was a seedy place which made the roughest cantina on [[Tolea Biqua]] look nice. It had a circular bar in the middle staffed by the [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] [[Garnt]], and had a perpetually hazy atmosphere. [[Gambling/Legends|Gambling]] was popular within, with games being run at most of the tables, be it [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] or other forms such as the chip-shuffling game run by [[Luco]]. [[Vel Pastar]] could typically be found seated in the deepest, darkest table in the cantina, with his daughter [[Kor Pastar|Kor]] doing recon for him.
